newsitem.title: EGYPT: SCFM nine-mth profits up on full yr.
newsitem.headline: SCFM nine-mth profits up on full yr.

text.p: Egyptian Southern Cairo Flour Mills made net after-tax profits of 19.220 million pounds in the first nine months of financial year 1995/6, against 19.076 million in the full year 1994/5, according to unaudited results available on Monday. The financial year ends on June 30.
Turnover rose to 357.058 million pounds, 20 percent up on 297.548 million in the full year. Profits before tax were 25.973 million, up on 24.100 million.
Shareholders' equity rose to 57.152 million pounds at the end of the nine-month period, against 42.711 million at the end of 1994/95.
The state sold the private sector 40 percent of the company's three million shares in June at 26.00. The shares closed on Sunday at 54.68 pounds.
